title: PR automation follows source observations and retries failed reads
description: Use a pre-client rule fixture and disabled synthetic push registration on the private gateway. Prove actual source writes and read-error Retry. No scans, providers, worker commands, live push or client-state injection.

proofTargets.claim: An external rule replacement updates the mounted rule without Refresh.
A disabled private registration updates the mounted notification inventory without exposing its token.
A live source error exposes enabled Retry; only failed queries reread and source repair restores readiness.

prove.intent: Prove PR configuration writers and error-only Retry on the isolated gateway.
